newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Filter agrees to buy Utility Supply.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Filter agrees to buy Utility Supply.

text.p: United States Filter Corp. said Friday it agreed to purchase The Utility Supply Group, Inc. of Waco, Texas, for $22 million in stock.
U.S. Filter said it will also assume about $24 million in Utility Supply Group's debt.
Utility Supply provides water and wastewater related products and services to industrial and municipal customers. It had revenues in 1995 of $157 million.
U.S. Filter provides industrial and commercial water and wastewater treatment systems and services. The company said the deal will lead to an increase in its earnings this year.
In May, U.S. Filter bought Davis Water and Waste Industries for $100 million. In June the company purchased Zimpro Environmental for $20 million in stock.
U.S. Filter stock rose $1.625 to $26 in afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
